known_limitations: Handwritten functions only; no model weights or model service
Timing includes compilation and is not a performance benchmark
Float32 assertions use rtol=2e-5 and atol=2e-6 on the listed finite inputs; no unrestricted IEEE proof
NaN, infinity, overflow, and exceptional floating-point modes are not verified
Selected upstream tests are material only; full upstream suite not executed
Complete native PyTorch source build and GPU backends are not qualified
Official wheel tags give minimum manylinux platform floor; host C++ JIT compiler must be functional and compatible with its system runtime

provenance.acceptance_scope: 12 actual CPU Inductor function executions, 176 float32 values, 8 generated kernels; dynamic shapes, noncontiguous inputs, numerical reduction, matmul+bias+ReLU, Tensor.item graph breaks and fullgraph rejection
provenance.binary_origin: Official PyTorch CPU wheel index; complete private 11-wheel library closure
provenance.final_guard_change: After the successful serial run, added explicit rejection of disabled assertions and Python environment optimization removal; exercised rejection directly. CPG integration will rerun the finalized checker from clean prefixes.
provenance.initial_failure: First trial OOM killed during initial compilation under shared 8 GiB memory cgroup. Failure retained, never counted as passed. Complete serial retry passed.
provenance.installation: SHA-verified direct wheel expansion following wheel .data installation schemes; no ambient Python packages
provenance.offline_execution: Executed under syscall guard denying AF_INET/AF_INET6 sockets, with local AF_UNIX permitted; one compile thread and one CPU math thread
provenance.source_scope: Full _inductor, _dynamo and _functorch compiler Python sources in official wheel; selected exact-commit upstream tests and documentation, not a complete native source checkout

requirements: glibc >=2.28 for pinned manylinux wheel closure; platform libstdc++, libgcc_s and standard C runtime
Working C++17 compiler (GCC or compatible), binutils and platform C/C++ development headers for actual Inductor compilation
No network or external Python packages required at runtime; local AF_UNIX IPC permitted
